response.original_title: David Walliams accused of targeting teens as young as 15
response.overview: David Walliams has been a staple on British TV for more than 20 years, featuring on shows like Little Britain, Come Fly With Me, and Britain's Got Talent - but multiple women have accused the comedian of targeting them for sex when they were teenagers, after a three-year-long joint investigation by ITV News and The Guardian.
response.title: David Walliams accused of targeting teens as young as 15
